arcs.selector: path.arc, path[class*='arc'], path[class*='segment'], path[class*='slice'], g[class*='arc'] > path, g[class*='segment'] > path
arcs.note: Three-level sunburst: 4 div + 12 dept + 24 team = 40 inner arcs. Min=36 allows sparse builds; max=120 accommodates outer-ring arcs sharing the same class plus shadow/clip arcs.

outer_ring.selector: path[class*='outer'], path[class*='ring'], path[class*='secondary'], path[class*='headcount'], path[class*='head'], path[class*='hc'], path[class*='band'], path[class*='halo'], g[class*='outer'] > path, g[class*='ring'] > path, g[class*='hc'] > path
outer_ring.note: Required: outer concentric ring encoding headcount per leaf. Observed names: outer-arc, head-ring, hc-arc, band, halo.

labels.note: At minimum, depth-1 division labels should be present.

tooltip.note: Tooltip element must exist in DOM. Observed ids: #tooltip, #tip.

encodings.note: Arc fill or stroke encodes division/depth via a categorical color scale.

hover.note: path.arc covers most models (opus, gpt-5.5, deepseek). path.main-arc covers claude-sonnet-4-6 (class='rarc main-arc'). .last avoids depth-1 arcs covered by deeper arcs in SVG paint order.

tooltip_appears.note: Hover changes DOM (tooltip populates); checked via innerHTML length diff. Same trigger as hover — one dispatch checks both effects.

notes: outer_ring selector expanded post-calibration: observed names include outer-arc, head-ring, hc-arc across frontier and opencode models.
tooltip selector expanded to include #tip (used by claude-opus-4-7).
path-to-root-highlights fix in structural.sh: SVG el.className is SVGAnimatedString; now uses getAttribute-based querySelector.
hover and tooltip_appears share the same trigger; structural.sh groups them into one dispatch.
interaction trigger expanded 2026-05-02: path.main-arc added for claude-sonnet-4-6 (uses class rarc main-arc, not plain arc).
Calibrated 2026-05-02 against 9 real outputs (frontier-only + opencode-broad sunburst run).
